_comment: Seed URLs for the district / education-foundation crawl.
These enumerate AWARDS STUDENTS CAN APPLY TO, already filtered for open,
local, and current -- the three criteria that cost ~60% of the BMF funnel.
Every URL here was surfaced by search on 2026-08-07 and is real, but none
could be fetched from the build sandbox (egress proxy denies CONNECT), so
none has been content-verified. Treat 'status' as unconfirmed until a run
with real egress fills it in.
kind: hub = one application covers many named awards (highest value);
list = enumerated links/PDF; meta = a list of other lists.

seeds.note: Hundreds of awards, $500-$20,000, ONE online application. Opens Oct 1, deadline ~Jan 31. Grades 11-12, Hillsborough County.

seeds.org: LEAP Tampa Bay College Access Network
Brooks DeBartolo Collegiate HS student services
seeds.note: Single-school counselor list. Pattern to replicate across every high school.
Publishes an annual scholarship FAQ + catalog PDF; locate the current year's catalog at crawl time.

seeds.org: Pasco Schools - Zephyrhills HS college & career centre
seeds.note: Counselor-maintained list of local + degree-specific awards.
Publishes per-school scholarship opportunity PDFs (e.g. Land O' Lakes HS).
Explicitly labelled 'Sarasota County Scholarships Database'. Highest-value single target in the pilot.
Known from earlier research to run many named funds behind a common application.

seeds.org: Public Education Foundation of Manatee County

seeds.note: Found ON the Zephyrhills HS page during the first harvest -- the district's own database, which the counselor page merely links to. Higher-value than the school page that pointed at it.
220+ endowed and 50+ annual scholarships, one online application, matched to donor criteria. Surfaced by the first harvest. AcademicWorks platform.
Referenced repeatedly by the Manatee Education Foundation directory as the place where several named funds actually live.

A list of local scholarship resources BY COUNTY, statewide. This is the single highest-leverage URL for scaling the pilot to all 67 Florida counties -- crawl it first and it generates the seed list for everywhere else.
